title: Canonical finite-Tor compact-support and exceptional compositor maps
statement:
Fix the finite-field and coefficient datum $D,B$ of [sk-def-sf-setting] and the specified operations of [sk-def-sf-operations]. For a finite coefficient stage $(E,n)$ with $n\ge1$, write $\mathcal C_{T,E,n}=\Dctf(T,\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n)$ for the finite-Tor constructible category, and $\mathcal D_{T,E,n}$ for the constructible category underlying the finite operations. Define $i_T:\mathcal C_{T,E,n}\to\mathcal D_{T,E,n}$ to be the full-subcategory inclusion, forgetting only the finite-Tor condition.

Let $h:U\to V$ be a separated finite-type morphism between finite-type $k$-schemes, let $c_h$ be a compactification, and let $P_h$ be a normalized system of constructible operations and adjunctions as in [lem-sf-constructible-exceptional-adjunction-coefficients]. Write $F_h$ for its finite-stage compact-support operation and $S_h$ for the specified finite constructible compact-support operation. Define $\lambda_h:i_VF_h\xrightarrow\sim S_hi_U$ as the unique lift through the fully faithful inclusion into the ambient derived category of the composite of the normalized realization of $F_h$, the canonical finite-image comparison, and the inverse of the specified realization of $S_h$.

For composable separated finite-type morphisms $f:X\to Y$, $g:Y\to Z$, put $x=g\circ f$. Choose compactifications $c_f,c_g,c_x$, and normalized systems $P_f,P_g,P_x$ at these maps. Let $\gamma:S_x\xrightarrow\sim S_gS_f$ be the canonical compactification composition isomorphism of [thm-sf-comp-composition], with functors here written in application order. Define $\alpha:F_gF_f\xrightarrow\sim F_x$ as the unique lift through $i_Z$ of the pasted isomorphism obtained by applying $\lambda_g$, then $\lambda_f$, then $\gamma^{-1}$, then $\lambda_x^{-1}$, with the canonical functor associators. Thus the ambient image of $\alpha$ is the specified compactification compositor; it is not an arbitrary isomorphism.

Finally, let $X,Y,Z$ be schemes and let $s$ be any one coefficient stage of [lem-sf-constructible-exceptional-adjunction-coefficients]. For operations $A:F_A\dashv G_A$, $H:F_H\dashv G_H$, $K:F_K\dashv G_K$ between $\mathcal C_{X,s},\mathcal C_{Y,s}$, between $\mathcal C_{Y,s},\mathcal C_{Z,s}$, and between $\mathcal C_{X,s},\mathcal C_{Z,s}$, respectively, and a specified $\alpha:F_HF_A\xrightarrow\sim F_K$, define $c:G_AG_H\xrightarrow\sim G_K$ to be the conjugate isomorphism of $\alpha^{-1}$ under the composite adjunction and $F_K\dashv G_K$, in the sense of [def-weil-pbc-adjunction-conjugate].
